name: North-American Islamic Shelter for the Abused
mission: NISA strives to create a more just community in which people of all cultures and beliefs can participate. Our primary goal is to reduce the incidents of domestic violence and achieve domestic harmony among families through collaborative efforts with the community and other established organizations. We provide shelter and support services to the abused. NISA seeks to increase awareness about domestic violence in our community at large. Help is free, available and should be sought before family problems become irreparable.
theoryOfChange: Our approach is to handle domestic violence while incorporating a spiritual dimension, which is necessary to deliver effective services and sustain efforts.

rich_narrative.summary: The North-American Islamic Shelter for the Abused offers confidential support, counseling, translation services, and a dedicated shelter known as the NISA Home. Founded in 2002, the organization empowers survivors of domestic violence in the Bay Area. In FY2025, the charity reported <cite id="1">a Total Revenue of $734,766</cite> to deliver direct services to victims. The organization maintains a modest operating overhead with <cite id="2">a program expense ratio of 72.5% in FY2025</cite> and high efficiency in fundraising, spending <cite id="2">only $0.02 per $1 raised</cite>. However, financial metrics show shifting stability. Financial filings show <cite id="1">revenue declined 19%</cite> from $778,560 in FY2023 to $633,502 in FY2024. The charity also holds an unusually large cash balance, maintaining <cite id="2">177.7 months of working capital in reserve</cite>. Independent evaluators give the charity <cite id="2">an overall score of 64.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting an average rating for accountability and leadership.
